purpose: Pre-registered acceptance criteria that turn a surfaced CANDIDATE into an outward DISCOVERY claim. The criteria are frozen HERE, before any prospective dataset is looked at, so the bar cannot be moved after seeing the result -- the exact failure p99 (prospective held-out) punished by returning DIVERGENT. This file is the authority for what 'earned' means; src/discover/discoveryGate.ts evaluates against it and nothing else.

honesty.nominationIsNotAClaim: A 'nomination' says: on this one candidate every independent bar passed. It does NOT say 'we discovered a planet'. The hard discoveryClaim boolean stays false at nomination tier.
honesty.discoveryClaimNeeds: discoveryClaim=true is permitted ONLY at the announcement tier, which additionally requires (a) a prospective-validation record whose precision clears the floor below, and (b) an explicit human/peer sign-off. No automated path may set it.
honesty.redLines: No planet discovery is claimed by this rig until a specific candidate clears every bar below on never-tuned-forward data AND a human signs the announcement.

tiers.none: One or more prerequisites unmet. Candidate may still be listed for follow-up; nothing claimed.
tiers.nomination: All per-candidate corroboration + significance bars pass and the protocol is pre-registered. Wording is bounded to 'nominated, pending independent confirmation'. discoveryClaim=false.
tiers.announcement: Nomination bars pass AND prospective validation clears its floor AND a human sign-off is present. This is the only tier where discoveryClaim may be true, and it is still gated by the human step.

significanceBars.note: FAR uses the AR(1)-model null (src/detect/significance.ts calibratedFap), the model p98 showed cuts FAR ~30% -> ~0% versus the model-free block surrogate at red-noise rho ~0.3.

prospectiveValidation.method: Pre-register the operating point, freeze it, then apply to a forward / never-tuned dataset (new TIC targets fetched after freezing, or time-forward sectors), and report precision (Wilson 95% lower bound) and the expected number of false claims at the announcement threshold.
prospectiveValidation.currentKnownGap: p99 measured retrospective-then-held-out precision at only 0.43-0.61 (DIVERGENT). Until a genuine prospective run clears the floor above, no candidate can reach the announcement tier, so discoveryClaim remains false everywhere -- which is the honest state, not a bug to toggle around.
